    colors = []

            colors.append(value)

    # including any other shapes that may appear in the generated output area.
    template = [(r, c) for r in range(key_top) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in template)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in template)

        top = first_top + i * height
        for dr, dc in shape:
            rr, cc = top + dr, c0 + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
